key_insight: The paper shows that logical CCZ states can be prepared directly and efficiently on BT/BB codes by combining native cup-product CCZ gates with engineered logical coupling and lifted ancillas.
engineering_relevance: This offers a lower-overhead route to fault-tolerant Toffoli-gate resources, which are critical for quantum arithmetic and scalable quantum algorithms.
method: Use projection-preserving lifts to couple bivariate tricycle (BT) and bicycle (BB) codes logically.
Employ index-2 lifted BB ancillas for selective Z-basis initialization and direct preparation of two disjoint logical CCZ states.
Transfer the prepared states into index-3 lifted BB memories and apply decoder-based postselection for cleanup.
evidence_signal: Exact circuit-level simulations under neutral-atom-motivated noise reported joint infidelities of 1.84×10^-5 at 21.94% acceptance and 4.10×10^-7 at 8.89% acceptance for the stated error rates.
watch_item: The protocol depends on postselection and specialized lifted-code hardware structure, so real-device performance will hinge on how well the assumed noise model and logical couplings match hardware.
